Interview: L5 System Design (Cloud AI Engineer / TSC)
Raw Notes:
- Candidate seemed a bit hesitant at first, maybe nervous, felt like a good culture fit.
- Immediately clarified tenant count (40 tenants), p95 latency (<2.5s), and freshness (<5 min).
- Independently compared dense-only vs hybrid BM25 + vector search + cross-encoder reranker and budgeted 120ms for reranking.
- On LLM quota spikes, initially only said exponential backoff; after a hint about noisy neighbors, added per-tenant token-bucket rate limiting and flash-model fallback.
- Ran out of time before discussing tenant ACLs, PII redaction, prompt-injection guardrails, or observability.

Interview: L3 Coding (Cloud AI Engineer)
Raw Notes:
- Candidate was very likable and energetic.
- Clarified input list format and wrote a clean O(n) hash map solution in Python with readable variable names.
- Declared done without tracing an example; after I prompted about empty lists, added a guard check.
- Did not ask about or test duplicate keys or null inputs.
